projects.title: Woven Pavilion
projects.description: Temporary structure exploring textile logic at architectural scale using bamboo.
projects.body: A temporary pavilion exploring textile logic at architectural scale.

blocks.text: This project investigates how textile logic—weaving, tension, and pattern—can be translated to an architectural scale. Using bamboo as the primary material, the pavilion explores temporary occupation and low-impact construction while maintaining a strong spatial presence.
Bamboo members are woven using form-finding strategies adapted from Kangaroo physics simulation, translating fabric behavior into a inhabitable structure.
